 About the match
 On this page you can find the Sassuolo vs Fiorentina match lineup for Serie A — Round 10 - First Leg, on Monday 02-11-2026, along with the substitutes and the players missing from the squad. Sassuolo lines up in a 4-3-3 led by Berardi, while Fiorentina sets up in a 4-3-3 led by Gea. Sassuolo is led by head coach Alberto Aquilani, while Fiorentina is managed by Paolo Vanoli. The match is played at Stadio Mapei - Citta del Tricolore.
